project.project_title: I want to publish my paperback book. I am looking for an editor who can help me polish my manuscript

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hello [FREELANCER_NAME_001], thanks for getting back to me.

I am a mother, and this book draws both from my own experiences and experiences borrowed from others. It explains how new parents can establish boundaries without having awkward conversations, as well as how visitors should behave around a newborn and the new parents. It is a guide addressing the question every exhausted new Indian parent struggles to answer: 'When can you visit, how long can you stay, and please don't kiss my baby.' I have included checklists, Do's & Don'ts tables, and several anecdotes. This is my first experience as an author, so I would value your support in successfully publishing the paperback. Essentially, I need help fine-tuning the book so that readers find it delightful and then getting it published successfully.

Could you please assist me with the following:
1\. What approach should we take?
2\. What would the price and timelines be?

value_updates.editorial_objective: Fine-tune the book so it is a delight to readers.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: The contract appears to be paused, although I have completed the editing work.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hello [FREELANCER_NAME_001], I’ve accepted nearly all of the track changes and added a few more details. For some reason, the track changes do not seem to appear correctly for the sections I added, although they may be visible and I’m just not sure. To avoid any confusion, I highlighted all my added sections in YELLOW.

I need clarification on the following:
1\. Is this sentence structured correctly: "So, I used to eat before anyone or sometimes after everytime, basically it was on demand."?
2\. Regarding this section, " The thing I needed most from my partner was not grand gestures. Sometimes, I needed him to answer the door when people came. Sometimes, its checking if my water bottle is filled, if my water bottle is near me, sometimes a hug. Sometimes just to check in on me. Sometimes to put a blanket on me. I needed him to manage the visitors so I did not have to. Small things. But they meant everything.")"—it does not sound like something I actually experienced; instead, it sounds as though I wished it had happened. How can it be restructured to show that this was my real experience? For instance, he did check up on me, and he used to fill my bottle and place it within a hand's reach.

value_updates.meal_timing_sentence: Correct the grammar and flow of the specified sentence about eating on demand.
value_updates.personal_experience_voice: Rewrite the partner-support passage so it clearly describes events the author experienced rather than wishes.

source_message.speaker: client

Also, let’s use the 2 revisions you suggested:
1\. So, I ate whenever I was hungry. Sometimes I ate before everyone else, and sometimes afterwards. My meals were completely on demand.

Sometimes he would simply check in on me, give me a hug, or put a blanket over me. He managed the visitors so I didn't have to. They were small acts, but they meant everything.
